prompt: Create an original 90 second cool jazz instrumental composition for puzzle game, strategy and patient problem solving. Mood: curious, playful, precise. Instruments: muted trumpet, vibraphone, double bass, brushes. Style: spare melodic answers, extended chords and unhurried swing. Tempo approximately 86 BPM; C lydian. Main idea: a descending melody with an upward answer. Use offset accents and question-and-answer motifs without dramatic shocks. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:30] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:30-01:00] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:00-01:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 01:30.

description.en: A lively and playful big band jazz piece featuring prominent brass and woodwind melodies over a walking bass line and swinging drum rhythm. The arrangement is dynamic with call-and-response sections and a cheerful, energetic feel.
description.zh: 一首活泼俏皮的大乐队爵士乐曲，以突出的铜管和木管旋律为主，配以行进贝斯线和摇摆的鼓点节奏。编曲充满活力，有呼应部分，整体感觉欢快而充满能量。
